subject.title: Control UI: Debug snapshot refresh has no progress indicator and silently fails when disconnected

question: Should maintainers adopt or rebase the open fork PR for the Debug Snapshots fix, or close that path and let a fresh narrow fix proceed from this issue?
rationale: The source bug is clear, but the open closing PR is conflicting and unmerged, so automation should not create a duplicate fix until maintainers choose the PR path.

options.title: Close the fork path and queue a fresh fix
options.body: Close or supersede the conflicting fork PR, then let a new narrow Control UI fix address this issue with localized copy, tests, and visual proof.

options.title: Adopt and rebase the fork PR
options.body: Have a maintainer or contributor rebase the fork branch and repair it against current Debug page structure before review.

recommendation.title: Close the fork path and queue a fresh fix
recommendation.body: Close or supersede the conflicting fork PR, then let a new narrow Control UI fix address this issue with localized copy, tests, and visual proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest history on the Debug page wiring and recent Control UI page split touched by the fix.
